# xterm serialize addon

Published @xterm/addon-serialize0.14.0 ESM and declarations, matched to xterm6.0.0. Runtime ESM is unmodified. Declaration extension is renamed to `.d.mts` and its ambient module wrapper removed for direct ESM import. Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/6.0.0/addons/addon-serialize . MIT license from the same source tag is included and collected by the frontend license pipeline (the npm tarball omits it).

Tarball was SHA512-verified against the exact registry version integrity before extraction. No dependency installation or lockfile changes. Used only to transfer bounded terminal screen/history/modes to a detached renderer; main window retains the PTY.
